summary: Wellchange Holdings (Nasdaq: WCT), a Hong Kong-based enterprise software provider, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a 1-for-10 reverse stock split of its Class A ordinary shares, effective at market open on November 9, 2026. The split reduces outstanding Class A shares from roughly 10,581,089 to about 1,058,109, with a new CUSIP G9545M149; Class B shares are unaffected. Shareholders and the board approved it, fractional shares round up, and no price, premium or advisor is stated. This is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation; watch post-split liquidity and Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance.
